provenance.note: Authored directly from a /grill-with-docs interview (2026-07-08, 13 locked decisions) plus three Codex research reports (Ontology-Playground survey, beep repo capability inventory, graph rendering performance landscape) saved verbatim under research/.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as PRs driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor); each phase lands through yeet and P5's PR must be mergeable.

phases.name: Bootstrap
phases.exit: Branch from fresh origin/main; packet sources confirmed; capability-report facts re-verified or drift recorded.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.exit: ontology slice (domain+use-cases+server) and drivers/n3 land; fixture ontologies round-trip by rdf-canonize fingerprint; slice tests green in isolation.

phases.name: Explorer + Editor
phases.exit: client + ui packages land; author-edit-save loop works in the running desktop app with undo/redo and change log.

phases.name: Visualizer
phases.exit: drivers/cosmos viewport with worker projection, focus-neighborhood, light editing; synthetic 100k-element ontology interactive on webkitgtk with benchmark note in history/.

phases.name: SPARQL + Reasoning
phases.exit: drivers/oxigraph implements the @beep/semantic-web SPARQL contract; query panel executes SELECT/CONSTRUCT; inferred-view toggle shows closure/type/disjointness signals.

phases.name: Harden + Close
phases.exit: Protege/ROBOT interop evidence recorded; all SPEC acceptance criteria pass; disambiguation notes added; closeout reflection exists; final PR mergeable.

stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
The implementation would exceed named scope.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
cosmos.gl proves non-viable on webkitgtk during the P3 spike (pre-approved fallback: sigma.js v3 + graphology).
